Textbook Hub

Easily buy and sell second-hand textbooks with AI-powered price suggestions and instant delivery coordination.

Features

Textbook Listing

Users can upload textbook listings with title, author, edition, and condition.

Filtering Search Results

Users can filter search results by title, author, price, and location.

Textbook Details

Users can view detailed information about a textbook, including price, condition, and seller contact.

AI-Powered Price Suggestions

The platform provides AI-powered price suggestions for textbook listings based on market trends and demand.

Instant Delivery Coordination

The platform connects buyers and sellers for instant delivery coordination, ensuring textbooks arrive on campus.

User Profile and Reputation System

Users can create profiles and build reputations based on their transaction history and reviews.

Payment and Transaction Management

The platform securely manages payments and transactions, ensuring a smooth and trustworthy experience.

Campus Map and Location-Based Search

Users can search for textbooks by location and view a campus map to find textbooks near them.
